answer: A harbor can resist fake identities by making influence grow like an orchard, not bought in bulk. Each identity is given one small orchard plot and must tend it across several seasons, with neighbors inspecting the work and pruning sloppy care. A wanderer who merely passes through gains nothing, because standing accrues only from continuous care of the same plot. Abandoning a plot forfeits its standing, and plots cannot be merged or sold. An attacker wanting a hundred votes must tend a hundred plots every season, paying full labor each time, while an honest participant tends only one.
